result.description: Nebra Quill 27Q is a fictional 27-inch IPS desktop monitor conceived for quiet studio work, document editing, and color-accurate everyday viewing. It features a 2560x1440 resolution, slim matte bezel design, and a fully adjustable stand with tilt, swivel, pivot, and height support. The panel is specified for 100% sRGB coverage, anti-glare coating, and low-blue-light modes for long sessions. Connectivity includes DisplayPort, HDMI, and a USB-C input for single-cable laptop use. It is positioned as a general-purpose productivity display rather than a storage or graphics device.
